# Software Bill of Materials

Human-readable rendering of [sbom.cdx.json](sbom.cdx.json) (CycloneDX 1.6, document version 9) for **dev-setup** — Interactive, idempotent dev-toolchain installer for Ubuntu 26.04 (with target-OS selection), plus a native winget-based Windows installer

**138 components** (50 application, 4 container, 80 library, 4 machine-learning-model). Generated by `scripts/sbom-md.py`; CI fails if this file is out of date with the CycloneDX source.
